nodes.description: Mapping address => uint256 holding the token balance of every account.
Nested mapping address => address => uint256 holding approval allowances.
Total token supply, set once in the constructor.
Address that receives the entire initial supply.
ERC20 token name string.
ERC20 token symbol string.
ERC20 decimals value used to scale the supply.
Constructor: initializes name, symbol, decimals, owner and mints the total supply.
Returns the token name.
Returns the token symbol.
Returns the number of decimals.
Returns the total token supply.
Returns the balance of a given account.
Public transfer that forwards msg.sender, recipient and amount to _transfer.
Returns the allowance an owner granted to a spender.
Public approval that forwards msg.sender, spender and amount to _approve.
Spends an allowance, moves tokens and decreases the allowance.
Internal transfer routine that mutates _balances and emits Transfer.
Internal approval routine that writes _allowances and emits Approval.
Caller-controlled address, used as transfer source and allowance owner.
Unchecked subtraction _balances[sender] -= amount (Solidity 0.6, no SafeMath).
Unchecked addition _balances[recipient] += amount (Solidity 0.6, no SafeMath).
Unchecked in-place subtraction of the allowance for msg.sender.
Unchecked multiplication _totalSupply = 10000 * (10 ** _decimals) during construction.
Parameter recipient of transfer/transferFrom, the destination of the moved tokens.
Parameter amount of transfer/approve/transferFrom/_transfer, the value being moved.
Parameter spender of approve/allowance, the address receiving the allowance.
Parameter sender of transferFrom/_transfer, the token source address.
Parameter account of balanceOf, the queried address.
Parameter owner of allowance/_approve, the address granting the allowance.

edges.reason: msg.sender is passed as the sender argument of _transfer inside transfer, so the untrusted caller directly determines whose balance is debited.
msg.sender is used as the owner argument of _approve inside approve, making the approval authorization caller-dependent.
msg.sender is the spender whose allowance is checked and decremented in transferFrom.
Caller-supplied recipient flows into transfer and is forwarded to _transfer.
Caller-supplied amount flows into transfer and is forwarded to _transfer.
Caller-supplied recipient flows into transferFrom.
Caller-supplied amount flows into approve and is written to _allowances.
Caller-supplied sender flows into transferFrom and is used as the allowance owner and token source.
The sender parameter of _transfer drives the subtraction from _balances[sender].
Caller-supplied spender flows into approve and becomes the allowance spender.
The spender parameter selects the allowance value returned by allowance.
The owner parameter selects the allowance value returned by allowance.
The owner parameter is the key written in _allowances inside _approve.
The account parameter indexes _balances in balanceOf.
The recipient parameter of _transfer drives the addition to _balances[recipient].
The amount parameter of _transfer is the value applied to both balance mutations.
transfer calls the internal _transfer helper.
transferFrom calls the internal _transfer helper.
transferFrom calls _approve to decrement the spent allowance.
approve calls the internal _approve helper.
_transfer performs the unchecked subtraction of the sender balance.
_transfer performs the unchecked addition to the recipient balance.
transferFrom performs the unchecked in-place allowance subtraction.
The constructor computes the total supply with an unchecked multiplication and exponentiation.
The unchecked subtraction mutates the _balances state mapping.
The unchecked addition mutates the _balances state mapping.
The unchecked allowance subtraction mutates the _allowances state mapping.
The unchecked multiplication result is stored into _totalSupply.
The total supply computation reads the _decimals state variable as the exponent.
_transfer reads and writes the _balances mapping.
balanceOf reads the _balances mapping.
The constructor writes the initial balance of the owner into _balances.
_approve writes the _allowances mapping.
allowance reads the _allowances mapping.
transferFrom reads and writes the _allowances mapping.
totalSupply reads the _totalSupply state variable.
The constructor assigns the _totalSupply state variable.
The constructor assigns the _owner state variable.
The constructor assigns the _name state variable.
The constructor assigns the _symbol state variable.
The constructor assigns the _decimals state variable.
name() reads the _name state variable.
symbol() reads the _symbol state variable.
decimals() reads the _decimals state variable.

normalization_plan.reason: The recipient parameter only exists to carry an external argument into the core transfer routine and has no independent semantics.
The amount parameter is a pure input carrier for the core transfer routine.
The spender parameter is only meaningful as the allowance target of the core approve routine.
The sender parameter is a transient input to the internal balance-mutating routine _transfer.
The account parameter is only used to index the balance mapping inside balanceOf.
The owner parameter is only used as the allowance key inside the core _approve routine.
